arxiv-1610-08149.title: Undercover EUV solar jets observed by the Interface Region Imaging Spectrograph
arxiv-1610-08149.creator: N.-H. Chen 1∗,2 and D. E. Innes 2
arxiv-1610-08149.description: A 2016 arXiv research paper by N.-H. Chen 1∗,2 and D. E. Innes 2. It is well-known that extreme ultraviolet (EUV) emission emitted at the solar surface is absorbed by overlying cool plasma. Especially in active regions dark lanes in EUV images suggest that much of the surface activity is obscured. Simultaneous observations from the Interface Region Imaging Spectrograph (IRIS), consisting of UV spectra and slit-jaw images (SJI) give vital information with sub-arcsecond spatial resolution on the dynamics of jets not seen in EUV images.

arxiv-2111-07091.title: WIMP Dark Matter in the U μ ​ ν ​ SSM \mu\nu{\rm SSM}
arxiv-2111-07091.creator: J. A. Aguilar–Saavedra, D. E. López-Fogliani, C. Muñoz, M. Pierre
arxiv-2111-07091.description: Abstract The U μ ​ ν \mu\nu SSM is a U ​ ( 1 ) ′ U(1)^{\prime} extension of the μ ​ ν \mu\nu SSM supersymmetric model, where baryon-number-violating operators as well as explicit mass terms are forbidden, and the potential domain wall problem is avoided.

arxiv-2204-06879.title: On n n -hereditary algebras and n n -slice algebras Thanks: This work is partly supported by National Natural Science Foundation of China #11671126, #12071120 and the Construct Program of the Key Discipline in Hunan Province
arxiv-2204-06879.creator: Jin Yun Guo and Yanping Hu
arxiv-2204-06879.description: Abstract . In this paper we show that acyclic n n -slice algebras are exactly acyclic n n -hereditary algebras whose ( n + 1 ) (n+1) -preprojective algebras are ( q + 1 , n + 1 ) (q+1,n+1) -Koszul. We also list the equivalent triangulated categories arising from the algebra constructions related to an n n -slice algebra.

arxiv-2208-04819.title: Wide-angle effects in multi-tracer power spectra with Doppler corrections
arxiv-2208-04819.creator: Pritha Paul, Chris Clarkson, Roy Maartens
arxiv-2208-04819.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Pritha Paul, Chris Clarkson, Roy Maartens. We examine the computation of wide-angle corrections to the galaxy power spectrum including redshift-space distortions and relativistic Doppler corrections, and also including multiple tracers with differing clustering, magnification and evolution biases. We show that the inclusion of the relativistic Doppler contribution , as well as radial derivative terms, are crucial for a consistent wide-angle expansion for large-scale surveys, both in the single and multi-tracer cases.

arxiv-2403-19049.title: Power and Play: Investigating “License to Critique” in Teams’ AI Ethics Discussions Conference: ACM Conference on Computer-Supported Cooperative Work; November 09–15, 2024; San José, Costa Rica Journal: PACMHCI 11
arxiv-2403-19049.creator: David Gray Widder, Laura Dabbish, James Herbsleb, Nikolas Martelaro
arxiv-2403-19049.description: Abstract . Past work has sought to design AI ethics interventions–such as checklists or toolkits–to help practitioners design more ethical AI systems. However, other work demonstrates how these interventions may instead serve to limit critique to that addressed within the intervention, while rendering broader concerns illegitimate.

arxiv-2409-03541.title: Submodularity of Mutual Information for Multivariate Gaussian Sources with Additive Noise
arxiv-2409-03541.creator: George Crowley, Iñaki Esnaola
arxiv-2409-03541.description: Abstract . Sensor placement approaches in networks often involve using information-theoretic measures such as entropy and mutual information. We prove that mutual information abides by submodularity and is non-decreasing when considering the mutual information between the states of the network and a subset of k k nodes subjected to additive white Gaussian noise.

arxiv-2501-03342.title: Recent star formation episodes in the Galaxy: impact on its chemical properties and the evolution of its abundance gradient
arxiv-2501-03342.creator: Tianxiang Chen, Nikos Prantzos
arxiv-2501-03342.description: Abstract Aims. We investigate the chemical evolution of the Milky Way disk exploring various schemes of recent (last several Gyr) star formation episodes, as reported in recent observational works. Methods. We use a semi-analytical model with parametrized radial migration and we introduce gaussian star formation episodes constrained by those recent observations. Results.

arxiv-2503-18380.title: Geometric properties versus particle motion in the Fan-Wang spacetime
arxiv-2503-18380.creator: Gulnara Suliyeva, Kuantay Boshkayev, Talgar Konysbayev, Yergali Kurmanov, Orlando Luongo, Marco Muccino, Hernando Quevedo, Ainur Urazalina, Farida Belissarova, Anar Dalelkhankyzy
arxiv-2503-18380.description: Abstract In this work, we explore general relativistic effects and geometric properties of the Fan-Wang spacetime, one of the simplest regular solutions that can be obtained in nonlinear electrodynamics. In particular, we investigate the motion of test particles, the capture cross-section of neutral massive and massless particles, such as neutrinos and photons, and the gravitational redshift.

arxiv-2504-17311.title: FLUKE : A Linguistically-Driven and Task-Agnostic Framework for Robustness Evaluation
arxiv-2504-17311.creator: Yulia Otmakhova, Hung Thinh Truong, Rahmad Mahendra, Zenan Zhai, Rongxin Zhu Daniel Beck Jey Han Lau
arxiv-2504-17311.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yulia Otmakhova, Hung Thinh Truong, Rahmad Mahendra, Zenan Zhai, Rongxin Zhu Daniel Beck Jey Han Lau. We present FLUKE ( f ramework for l ing u istically-driven and tas k -agnostic robustness e valuation), a task-agnostic framework for assessing model robustness through systematic minimal variations of test data. FLUKE introduces controlled variations across linguistic levels — from orthography to dialect and style varieties — and leverages large language models (LLMs) with human validation to generate modifications.

arxiv-2505-00044.title: Learning to Borrow Features for Improved Detection of Small Objects in Single-Shot Detectors
arxiv-2505-00044.creator: Richard Schmit Department of Mathematics Zewail City of Science & Technology October Gardens, Giza Governorate 12578, Egypt
arxiv-2505-00044.description: Abstract Detecting small objects remains a significant challenge in single-shot object detectors due to the inherent trade-off between spatial resolution and semantic richness in convolutional feature maps. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework that enables small object representations to "borrow" discriminative features from larger, semantically richer instances within the same class.

arxiv-2507-22824.title: Bi-Level Optimization for Self-Supervised AI-Generated Face Detection
arxiv-2507-22824.creator: Mian Zou, Nan Zhong, Baosheng Yu, Yibing Zhan, Kede Ma
arxiv-2507-22824.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mian Zou, Nan Zhong, Baosheng Yu, Yibing Zhan, Kede Ma. AI-generated face detectors trained via supervised learning typically rely on synthesized images from specific generators, limiting their generalization to emerging generative techniques. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a self-supervised method based on bi-level optimization.

arxiv-2509-20680.title: Can Federated Learning Safeguard Private Data in LLM Training? Vulnerabilities, Attacks, and Defense Evaluation
arxiv-2509-20680.creator: Wenkai Guo, Xuefeng Liu, Haolin Wang, Jianwei Niu, Shaojie Tang, Jing Yuan ♡ \heartsuit State Key Laboratory of Virtual Reality Technology and Systems,School of Computer Science and Engineering, Beihang University, Beijing, China ♢ \diamondsuit Hangzhou Innovation Institute of Beihang University, Zh
arxiv-2509-20680.description: Abstract Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) with local data is a widely adopted approach for organizations seeking to adapt LLMs to their specific domains. Given the shared characteristics in data across different organizations, the idea of collaboratively fine-tuning an LLM using data from multiple sources presents an appealing opportunity.

pmc-11306161.title: Loss of the putative Rab GTPase, Ypt7, impairs the virulence of Cryptococcus neoformans
pmc-11306161.creator: Guanggan Hu, Xianya Qu, Kabir Bhalla, Peng Xue, Erik Bakkeren, Christopher W. J. Lee, James W. Kronstad
pmc-11306161.description: Small GTPases of the Rab family coordinate multiple membrane fusion and trafficking events in eukaryotes. In fungi, the Rab GTPase, Ypt7, plays a critical role in late endosomal trafficking, and is required for homotypic fusion events in vacuole biogenesis and inheritance.

pmc-11348729.title: Integrating transcriptomics and proteomics to analyze the immune microenvironment of cytomegalovirus associated ulcerative colitis and identify relevant biomarkers
pmc-11348729.creator: Yang Chen, Qingqing Zheng, Hui Wang, Peiren Tang, Li Deng, Pu Li, Huan Li, Jianhong Hou, Jie Li, Li Wang, Jun Peng
pmc-11348729.description: BackgroundIn recent years, significant morbidity and mortality in patients with severe inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and cytomegalovirus (CMV) have drawn considerable attention to the status of CMV infection in the intestinal mucosa of IBD patients and its role in disease progression.

pmc-11507289.title: Myeloid GSK3α Deficiency Reduces Lesional Inflammation and Neovascularization during Atherosclerotic Progression
pmc-11507289.creator: Sarvatit Patel, Nisarg Shah, Brooke D’Mello, Anson Lee, Geoff H. Werstuck
pmc-11507289.description: The molecular mechanisms by which cardiovascular risk factors promote the development of atherosclerosis are poorly understood. We have recently shown that genetic ablation of myeloid glycogen synthase kinase (GSK)-3α attenuates atherosclerotic lesion development in low-density lipoprotein receptor-deficient (Ldlr−/−) mice. However, the precise contributions of GSK3α/β in atherogenesis are not known.

pmc-11516081.title: Preoperative Echocardiographic Assessment in Elective Surgery Patients: A Cross-Sectional Study From Duhok, Iraqi Kurdistan
pmc-11516081.creator: Ameen M Mohammad, Hakar M Mohammed
pmc-11516081.description: Background and aimEchocardiography plays a pivotal role in the preoperative risk assessment of patients undergoing various surgical procedures. Therefore, we conducted this study to detect various cardiac abnormalities through a preoperative echocardiographic study for cases undergoing elective surgeries in Duhok, Iraqi Kurdistan.

pmc-12604466.title: P-wave oversensing during atrial tachycardia in patients with an extravascular ICD
pmc-12604466.creator: Alexander Breitenstein, Stefan Simovic, Vera Maslova, Henrike Aenne Katrin Hillmann
pmc-12604466.description: mplantation was uneventful, and initial sensing parameters showed good ventricular signal amplitude with no significant P-wave oversensing during sinus rhythm. In both patients, the sensing vector was Ring1-Ring2 (near-field sensing between the sensing poles), with a ventricular sensitivity of 0.15 mV (standard recommendation).

pmc-12655811.title: Association Between Anxiety and Diet Quality Among Polish Adults: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-12655811.creator: Paulina Sławińska, Ewa Piotrowska, Karolina Rak, Ewa Raczkowska, María Teresa Iglesias-López
pmc-12655811.description: Background/Objectives: Anxiety can influence dietary choices and habits, but dietary choices and habits can also contribute to the intensification of anxiety symptoms. The study aimed to test the hypothesis that a higher level of anxiety predicts poorer diet quality among adults in Poland. Methods: A cross-sectional survey was conducted among 1841 individuals aged 18 years and older across Poland.

pmc-12745462.title: Microbial fertilizer for improving maize yield, straw decomposition and soil microbiome structure
pmc-12745462.creator: Xianjin Xie, Hua Tao, Yanan Li, Xueying Feng, Ke Li, Zhehui Zhang, Junying Yan, Xiaolin Wang
pmc-12745462.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Microbial fertilizers represent a promising strategy to sustainably produce crops by enhancing the biological function of soil and availability of nutrients. However, there is a lack of study on their performance across diverse agroecological zones. In this study, we conducted a 3-year, two-site field experiment to assess the effects of a composite microbial fertilizer (Bacillus subtilis and Trichoderma harzianum) on the yield of maize (Zea mays), soil properties, straw degradation, and composition of the microbial community.

pmc-12981499.title: Cure rate estimation with insufficient follow-up: A median-based bootstrap correction approach
pmc-12981499.creator: Yumiko Ibi, Takashi Omori
pmc-12981499.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The cure rate in clinical trials can be estimated using the Kaplan–Meier (KM) estimator. However, when the clinical trial follow-up period is insufficient and short, the KM estimator may overestimate the proportion of cured patients. Although a correction method was proposed by Escobar-Bach and Keilegom based on bootstrap sampling, this can also lead to bias when the bootstrap distribution is skewed. We propose a median-based approach for bootstrap samples to address these issues.

pmc-12999634.title: Real-world single-center analysis of efficacy and safety in newly diagnosed marginal zone lymphoma
pmc-12999634.creator: Xin Zhou, Jingshu Ruan, Yuqi Shi, Ningning Shan
pmc-12999634.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study aimed to analyze newly diagnosed marginal zone lymphoma (MZL) patients treated in the Department of Hematology at our center. A retrospective analysis was conducted to evaluate the efficacy and safety profiles of various treatment regimens for MZL. Data were retrospectively collected from 177 newly diagnosed MZL patients hospitalized in the Department of Hematology at Shandong Provincial Hospital Affiliated to Shandong First Medical University between October 2006 and October 2024.

pmc-13094037.title: A couple-based physical activity intervention for the prevention of gestational diabetes mellitus: study protocol for a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13094037.creator: Rong-rong Han, Jing Peng, Li Zhang, Jing Jin, Wen-xuan Lin, Li-juan Zheng, Ying Yu, Lei Zeng, Qian Xu, Dejian Zeng, Li Cheng, Ling-ling Gao
pmc-13094037.description: BackgroundEarly prevention of Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) is critical not only for protecting maternal and infant health but also for reducing the long-term healthcare burden associated with chronic diseases. Physical activity is a well-established modifiable behavior for GDM prevention; however, existing physical activity interventions during pregnancy have shown limited effectiveness.

pmc-13124352.title: Persistent 131I uptake in the thyroglossal duct after thyroid ablation: A case report and literature review
pmc-13124352.creator: Jie Qin, Ping Yu, Yu Long Zeng, Jing Ze Li, Xing yu Mu, Zu Guo Li, Wei Xia Chong, Lei Zhang, Bi yun Mo, Wei Fu
pmc-13124352.description: Rationale:Persistent midline radioiodine uptake after thyroid remnant ablation can mimic metastatic disease and lead to unnecessary re-treatment. We report a case of persistent iodine-131 (131I) uptake in the thyroglossal duct region with undetectable thyroglobulin (Tg).Patient concerns:A 45-year-old woman was found to have thyroid nodules on routine ultrasound, and further evaluation supported papillary thyroid carcinoma.

pmc-13269956.title: Treatment failure in suspected community-acquired pneumonia revealing a pulmonary abscess
pmc-13269956.creator: Sindhuja Earagolla, Noah Karnath, Sravya Borra, Bernard Karnath

pmc-13385805.title: OTUD5-TIF1γ-SMAD3/4 positive feedback loop inhibits TGF-β-induced EMT and metastasis in NSCLC
pmc-13385805.creator: Yong Wang, Runfeng Sun, Xiaochen Wang, Ersuo Jin, Lingji Hu, Xia Liu, Jie Huang, Xiaoyu Yin, Hao Shi, Chang Li, Jie Zhu, Guang Hu, Shengjie Wang, Jun Zhao, Hong-Tao Zhang
pmc-13385805.description: The molecular mechanisms underlying non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) metastasis remain incompletely understood, limiting the identification of potential therapeutic targets. Here, integrating clinical data, we identify ovarian tumor domain-containing protein 5 (OTUD5), an OTU family member of deubiquitinases, as a potential metastasis suppressor in NSCLC. Reduced OTUD5 expression is observed in metastatic NSCLC specimens and correlates with poor patient survival.

pmc-13478224.title: Capsular tension ring force line and intraocular lens angle on the impact of postoperative astigmatism in Marfan syndrome lens subluxation: a retrospective study
pmc-13478224.creator: Junjie Yang, Xuan Yu, Ling Jin, Yamin Mao, Guang Zhao, Yukan Huang
pmc-13478224.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). To investigate the influence of the angle between the tension ring force line and the intraocular lens (IOL) on residual astigmatism after lens replacement surgery in Marfan Syndrome (MFS) patients with subluxated lenses.

pmc-13524363.title: Change Adaptation Resilience Evaluation Questionnaire for Industry 5.0 Among Workers in High-Tech Manufacturing Companies: Questionnaire Development and Pilot Evaluation Study
pmc-13524363.creator: Giulia Bassi, Angelo Valente, Serena Tassoni, Silvia Salcuni
pmc-13524363.description: BackgroundDespite increasing recognition of human factors in technologically advanced manufacturing, psychological resilience remains an underexplored dimension. Existing studies often rely on generic instruments that fail to capture the specific adaptive challenges faced by workers in high-tech environments. There is a growing need for context-sensitive tools capable of assessing resilience in line with the human-centric vision of Industry 5.0.
